spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (हयति)
1 To move.
2 To worship.
3 To sound.
4 To be weary.

m. (-यः)
1 A horse.
2 A man of a particular class.
3 The number seven.
4

INDRA.
5
The

Yak.
6

(In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables, a proceleusmaticus.
f. (-यी)
A mare.
E.
हय to go, or हि to go, aff. अच्.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
हय a horse, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-वः)
A prince of the Daityas, who during BRAHMĀ'S sleep at the end of a Kalpa stole the Vedas; in the recovery of them, he was slain by VIṢṆU, after his descent as the Matsya or fish Avatāra.
E.
हय a horse, and ग्रीबा neck.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
हयग्रीव the Daitya, and हन् slayer.

m. (-षः)
1 A driver, a charioteer.
2 INDRA'S charioteer.
E.
हय a horse, and कष to hurt, aff. खच्.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A horse-dealer, a groom, one who is a judge of the qualities of a horse.
E.
हय, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
Horsemanship, knowledge of horses and their management.
E.
तल् added to the last.

m. (-न्)
The buffalo.
E.
हय, and द्विषत् foe.

n. (-नं)
A covered carriage.
m. (-नः)
A year.
E.
हय to go, ल्युट् aff.

mn. (-नः-नं)
A year.
m. (-नः)
1 A flame, a ray.
2 A sort of rice.
E.
हा to go or leave, ल्युट् aff., युक् augment.

m. (-च्छः)
A horse's tail.
f. (-च्छी)
A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
हय a horse, and पुच्छ the tail.

m. (-यः)
Barley.
E.
हय a horse, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-कः)
A shrub, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
हय a horse, and मारक killer; also with मार the same, हयमार m. (-रः.)

m. (-णः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
हय a horse, and मारण killing.

m. (-धः)
The sacrifice of a horse: see अश्वमेघ.
E.
हय, and मेध sacrifice.

m. (-नः)
1 The son of SŪRYA or the sun.
2 KUVERA.
E.
हय a horse, and वाहन a vehicle.

m. (-रः)
Mountain ebony, the red sort.

m. (-न्दः)
Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.
हय a horse, and आनन्द delighting.

m. (-रिः)
A shrub, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
हय a horse, and अरि inimical.

m. (-ठः)
A horseman, a rider.
E.
हय, and आरूढ mounted on.

m. (-हः)
Riding, horsemanship.
E.
हय, and आरीह mounting.

f. (-ना)
The gum Olibanum tree.
E.
हय a horse, and अशन food.

m. (-मः)
An excellent horse.
E.
हय a horse, and उत्तम best.
